name: PostgreSQL to Google Cloud Storage
steps:
1.  Create a data model and specify the [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html) from which you want the data for your Google Cloud Storage. If you have not yet added a data warehouse, go to [data warehouse](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/destinations/index.html#_datachannel_managed_warehouse) tab and add a warehouse.
2.  Authorise DataChannel to connect to your Google Cloud Storage.
3.  Click on **\+ Data Sync** to start adding data syncs to your account.

![gcs data sync detail](/images/cms/reverse-etl-destinations/gcs-data-sync-detail-965d55.png)

4.Details of individual syncs are available [here](https://docs.datachannel.co/getting-started/1.0.0/reverse_etl/destinations_retl/googlesheets/syncs.html).
